experience.role: Security Engineer, Delivery and Automation Team
bullets: Served as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in macOS Security, iOS Security, Python, and Security Automation.

Led the migration of EDR for 6000+ devices encompassing all three platforms (macOS, Linux, and Windows) from Crowdstrike to SentinelOne with 0 downtime to our Zero Trust security posture and 100% coverage.

Designed and developed an in-house Python based Mobile Device Management (MDM) tool, effectively managing over 10,000 mobile devices across the organisation. The infrastructure was hosted in GCP and managed by Terraform.
Spearheaded security automation efforts for enterprise security, streamlining processes and ensuring efficient implementation of automated controls.

Designed and developed an in-house JavaScript based scalable logging ingestion and enrichment pipeline for multiple SaaS applications, reducing processing time from 2 hours to just under 5 minutes. The infrastructure was hosted in Cloudflare and managed by Terraform.
Conducted privacy and reputation assessments for new vendors to ensure alignment with organisational security policies.

Designed and developed a FedRAMP compliant asset inventory system that automates aggregation of asset data, compiles compliance reports, and publishes audit-ready outputs, ensuring continuous alignment with regulatory requirements.
Eliminated a recurring bottleneck in Cloudflare’s Zero Trust posture checks, improving new-hire onboarding efficiency and reducing time-to-access for core applications from days to minutes.
Led the development of an internal GCP recommender system that provides recommendations for cost optimisation and resource utilisation, helping to reduce cloud costs and risks.

Contributed to the testing and deployment of a new EDR solution on Cloudflare production servers running on Linux, ensuring a smooth transition and maintaining the security posture of the 20% of the entire internet.
Served as a subject matter expert (SME) for macOS & iOS security, specialising in areas such as malware reversing, security tool implementation, etc.

Developed and deployed email and link security automation scanner. Those systems have more than 90% true positive rate based on on-call ticket resolution. The infrastructure was hosted in AWS and managed by Terraform.

Led the development and deployment of an internal macOS Sandbox Agent to perform automated malware analysis using Apple’s Endpoint Security Framework. Wrote 5 initial detection rules for the sandbox. The infrastructure was hosted in AWS.
Led the security audit automation initiative for third party risk management programme to improve efficiency and objectivity across all audit processes.

Led the culture of automatic service deployment by using GitHub repo branches to determine the deployment environment (staging/prod) and Jenkins to automate the process. Reduced deployment mistakes by 100%.
Participated in on-call rotation for malware, phishing, threat modelling on a new system and other corporate security related tasks.
Served as a subject matter expert for iOS application security.
Performed penetration testing and code review, preventing 3 critical vulnerabilities from making it into the production app.
Implemented improvements to enhance security posture such as SAST, DAST, and Dependency Tracker, including automated vulnerability scanning and dependency monitoring across the development lifecycle.

Developed and deployed a product security internal dashboard as a single source of truth for executives to learn initiatives and projects that are being explored by the team. Increased visibility and collaboration among stakeholders.
Owned the bug bounty process for Gopay, resulting in the identification and remediation of 30+ vulnerabilities.
Developed an internal Mobile App Security Testing automation system.
Served as a subject matter expert for iOS application engagement.
Successfully performed OTP bypass on several banking and e-commerce applications in Indonesia.
Found several critical vulnerabilities in banking & financial apps that can be used to steal money.
Bypassed many jailbreak detection frameworks & libraries used by many banking institutions in Indonesia and Singapore.
Wrote a Python service to automate API contract testing using Burp Suite active scanner, improving testing efficiency by 100%.
Wrote technical reports for vulnerabilities found and provided high-level recommendations on how to fix them.
